---
name: Task for an agent
about: A piece of work any coding agent (or person) can pick up and finish
labels: task
---

**Goal** (one or two sentences: what is true when this is done)

**Area and files** (which part of the app; the spec file in `docs/spec/` and the code files you know of)

**Acceptance** (what a reviewer checks; what must not change)

**How to verify** (the checks to add or run; `tools/check.sh` covers the usual ones)

**Needs a real phone?** (no / yes: what to try on it, and what you expect to see)

**Decisions that apply** (files in `docs/decisions/`, if any)
